Methodology.title: How we calculate
Methodology.winRate: Win rate counts wins and losses only; draws and byes are left out, and so are mirror matches. Every rate shows a 95% Wilson confidence interval.
Methodology.adjusted: Adjusted win rate adds 100 imaginary matches at 50%, so a legend with few games does not jump to the top by luck.
Methodology.conversion: Top 25% rate compares how many pilots of a legend finished in the top quarter of the Swiss standings with how many would be expected from its presence (1.00× is average).
Methodology.power: Power is the percentile (0 to 100) of 60% adjusted win rate plus 40% top 25% rate, both standardized. Tiers: S from 90, A from 70, B from 40, C from 15, D below.
Methodology.pilots: Best pilots are ranked by the lower bound of the 95% Wilson interval, with the sample size reduced by Kish's design effect, because matches from the same event are not fully independent.
Methodology.minimum: A legend needs at least {min} pilots in the selected set to enter the chart.
Methodology.source: Data comes from the public pages of official events on the organized play platform (UVS). The legend of each player is the one registered there; full decklists are not public.
Methodology.ranking: The player ranking adds up points for final placement in each finished event. Each event is worth a base by level: Regional Championship 1000, Regional Qualifier 500, Showdown 300 (512+ players), 200 (256+) or 120 (smaller), side events 60 and community events 40. The player earns a share of that base: 1st 100%, 2nd 70%, top 4 50%, top 8 35%, top 16 22%, top 32 14%, top 64 9%, top 128 5% and top 256 3%. Only the top quarter of each event scores (at least the top 8). Ties are broken by titles and then best finish. Results imported from TopDeck.gg appear as separate players when they could not be matched to the official platform.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: Central Riftbound is an unofficial, non-commercial fan site about the Riftbound trading card game. This page explains what we keep about you and why.
Privacy.signIn: Browsing the site needs no account. If you sign in with Discord or Google, that service sends us your account ID, e-mail address, name and avatar. We use them only to identify your account and never send you e-mails.
Privacy.stored: With an account, we store your display name, the decks you save, your complexity votes and the tournament decklists you submit (with you as the sender).
Privacy.public: Decks you mark as public or unlisted can be seen by others, together with your display name. Private decks are visible only to you.
Privacy.players: Player names and results come from the public results of official events. Any player can ask to have their name hidden from this site.
Privacy.cookies: We don't show ads, sell or share your data, or use tracking cookies. We only use cookies to keep you signed in and to remember your language.
Privacy.services: Data is stored with Supabase (database and sign-in), and the site is hosted by Vercel.
Privacy.delete: To delete your account and all its data, or to hide your name, contact {contact}. You can delete your saved decks yourself at any time.

Terms.title: Terms of use
Terms.intro: By using Central Riftbound you agree to these terms.
Terms.free: The site is free and provided as is. Statistics are computed from public tournament results and may contain errors; we don't guarantee that the site will always be available.
Terms.conduct: Don't use the site to harass anyone, post offensive deck names or descriptions, or flood it with automated requests. We may remove content or accounts that break these rules.
Terms.content: The decks you create are yours. By making a deck public or unlisted, you allow it to be shown on the site.
Terms.riot: Central Riftbound is not endorsed by Riot Games. Riftbound, its card names and images are trademarks and property of Riot Games.
Terms.changes: We may update these terms; the date at the top shows the latest version. Questions: {contact}.

Syntax.title: Search syntax
Syntax.lead: Combine filters in the card search and in the deckbuilder. Terms add up (AND); use “or” for alternatives and “-” to exclude.
Syntax.aliases: Fields also work in Portuguese (tipo, dominio, custo, poder, forca, texto, raridade), and domains accept fury/furia, calm/calma, mind/mente, body/corpo, chaos/caos, order/ordem.
